info.name: CloudLab API v1.0
info.description: Every endpoint from CloudLab API Contract v1.0 (section 7). Run a Login request first: it stores the token. Each request checks the { data } / { error } envelope and the X-Request-Id header. Backend person: test every endpoint here BEFORE telling the frontend it is ready (contract section 10).
